name: x402-java-ts-vectors
description: Exports TS reference behaviour as JSON fixtures for the Java v2 tests. Runs with the TS workspace's tsx and imports TS sources by relative path, so it needs no install of its own and never edits TypeScript.

scripts.export: npm run export:core && npm run export:bazaar && npm run export:cardano && npm run export:facilitator && npm run export:plutus
